spatialMethod.algorithm: point-in-polygon against simplified WGS 84 GeoJSON province polygons; polygon edges count as inside
spatialMethod.use: coarse consistency screen only; not a validated regional or marine-water assignment
spatialMethod.outsideLandPolygonInterpretation: can reflect a valid coastal/marine specimen coordinate and is not by itself a locality error
spatialMethod.boundaryYearLimit: 2020 boundaries, source data integrated 2023; not a current legal or municipal-water boundary

limitations: This check compares source province text with a point in a simplified 2020 land-administration polygon; it does not establish which municipality or waterbody a marine record belongs to.

Coastal and offshore points can be outside every land polygon without being erroneous. Coordinate-uncertainty radii were compared with approximate planar distance to the reported province boundary only for a review hint, not used to reassign any point.
Potential province mismatches remain a local manual review queue and are not automatic exclusions.
The simplified geometry is used only for screening; any future map or legal use needs a current, source-authorized geometry and exact-version review.
